card.name: Scattered words mid-sentence in dosing text
card.fires_on: No single word or setting; it fires on 'the', a space after 'to', a bullet dot in units, 'm' in µm, and a digit in an exponent. Most hits are in carboplatin dosing text.

modes.label: The after is
modes.description: The word 'the' right after 'is' before a noun phrase.

modes.label: Pieces of units and numbers
modes.description: Small pieces inside dose numbers and units, such as a space in a range, a dot in mg/mL•min, or 'm' in µm.

card.plain: It reacts to a mix of small, unrelated spots in dosing text, so no single pattern describes it.
